You see a life crystal.
It weighs 2.63 oz.

Notes

It looks the same as a Deep Crystal, a Gnomish Resonance Crystal, a Purified Soul, a Resonance Crystal, a Resonance Crystal (Recorded) and a Spectral Stone. It glows weakly in the dark. It can be traded for a Life Ring by speaking with Chester Kahs.
